exposure: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) diagnosed in early pregnancy
cohort: The study participants included 91 obese pregnant women with GDM diagnosed in early pregnancy and a control group of 10 age-matched pregnant women with normal BMI (<25 kg/m2).
finding: Adropin levels were significantly higher in obese pregnant women with GDM compared to controls, increased in the third trimester, and higher adropin levels were related to lower BMI and better metabolic control.
cross-section timing: Blood samples collected between 28th and 32nd week (V1) and between 37th and 39th week (V2) of gestation.
